interface.signature: def captainAmerica(N: int, M: int, V: List[List[int]]) -> int:

preconditions.description: N is the number of rooms (1 ≤ N ≤ 30000) and M is the number of gates (1 ≤ M ≤ 200000).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N and 1 <= q <= N for [p, q] in V)
preconditions.description: Each gate in V is a directed edge from room p to room q, where 1 ≤ p, q ≤ N.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len({u for u in range(1, N + 1) if all(any(has_path(u, v) for v in range(1, N + 1)) for v in range(1, N + 1))})
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of rooms u (1 ≤ u ≤ N) such that every other room v (1 ≤ v ≤ N) is reachable from u via some directed path in the maze. Here, has_path(u, v) is true if there exists a directed path from u to v.
